cs.t: I'd argue that given the max angle of the screen it cannot be used on your lap  I'd argue that the two years I spent using it as a laptop, largely on my lap, says it works fine. I also used it balanced on my knees, curled up in a window nook.

Yeah, when I say "nice" about the screen, it is all relative. Mine was nice compared to the original screen on the Model 1. There are very few pieces of laptop/notebook hardware that I really enjoyed. The 5140 was one of them. I doubt I'd enjoy it now, but 40 years ago I found it just lovely.
